programs.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race
programs.desc: Des Moines hosts its first-ever race as 25,000 fans watch racers ride their homemade soapboxes down a wild 295-yard course complete with split-second decisions, wipeouts and a three-way fight for the trophy.

programs.title: Gold Rush: White Water
programs.desc: After his biggest single day gold haul ever, Dustin and his crew double down on a new site, a treacherous plunge pool called the Dog Leg; up creek, winter's frozen grip tightens as Kayla and her crew battle to reach their bedrock payday.

programs.title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
programs.desc: Andrew tests a disturbing theory: is a secret, directed-energy weapon used in Venezuela the smoking gun behind unexplained attacks on U.S. government officials overseas? These invisible attacks led to the horrifying symptoms now known as Havana Syndrome.

programs.title: Jeff Dunham's The Cars That Drove Us
programs.desc: As people spend more time in cars, drivers crave the comforts of home; factory options like glove-box cocktail bars promise just that, though not all are created equal; join Jeff Dunham for a ride through the wacky world of factory options!

programs.title: The Fish Guyz
programs.desc: Join The Fish Guyz! Captain Lain Goodwin, Earl Byrd III, and an eclectic crew of local legends showcase the best fishing and tourism the Conch Republic offers. Professional chef Cat Pfeiffer demystifies seafood with simple recipes made for home kitchens.

programs.title: Sportsman's Adventures
programs.desc: Capts. Rick and Ridge Murphy get hooked up on kingfish in Fort Pierce, Fla., with Capt. Eric Davis.
